main.description: Ask an issuer whether a subject currently holds an entitlement with a creator. STANDING REQUIRED: the caller must be either (a) the subject themselves, proving their DID per SPEC §5.0 (an atproto inter-service auth JWT signed by their own PDS, or an OAuth session with this issuer), or (b) a service listed in the creator's offer record authorizedServices, authenticated via atproto inter-service auth with lxm set to this NSID — a token bound to any other method is not standing for (b). All other callers receive NoStanding regardless of whether the subject or any entitlement exists — this endpoint must never function as an enumeration oracle for third parties.

subject.description: DID whose entitlement is being checked.

creator.description: DID of the creator the entitlement is with.

tier.description: Optional tier id. If omitted, reports whether any tier is held.
Tier id currently held (highest, if several). Present only when active.

expiresAt.description: End of the currently paid period. Present only when active.

errors.name: NoStanding
errors.description: The caller is neither the subject nor a service designated by the creator. Returned uniformly, without revealing whether the subject or any entitlement exists.
